k_await_condition.why: poll-until-condition replaces sleep, removes timing races

k_cache_warm.why: cache warmer, unrelated to flaky tests

k_fixture_db.why: fresh transactional DB per test prevents cross-contamination flakes

k_freeze_clock.why: froze clock to stop midnight-boundary flaky assertion

k_isolate_shared_state.why: isolating shared state fixed order-dependent CI flakes

k_parametrize.why: parametrize for edge cases, not flakiness

k_seed_random.why: pinning RNG seed fixed shuffle-order failures
